Subject: Unit economics deep-dive follow-up / pricing qualification

Hi Claire / Sanjay — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can prepare a tailored pricing and unit-econ proposal before the next call:

TL;DR: we can usually get to a ~target cost with quantization + batching; need token volumes, features per request, and budget range to size a recommended config.

Recap from today's call:
- Primary use: conversational assistant + short-form generation (user messages ~20-80 tokens, model responses ~40-300 tokens)
- Expected steady-state: ~30M tokens / month; peak burst up to ~120M tokens / month (seasonal campaigns)
- Must-have: <200ms p95 latency for interactive flows, SSO + audit logs for compliance
- Business goals: target unit cost that supports $/feature targets and CAC payback within 6–9 months

Asks / next steps (so we can run the unit-econ model):
1) Confirm token estimate ranges (steady / peak / initial pilot). If you have a CSV or a sample traffic log, please attach.
2) Target $/1M tokens you want to hit (ballpark is fine).
3) Average number of key product "features" that rely on LLM per new user (to compute $/feature).
4) Any procurement constraints / budget windows (quarterly/annual commit?)

I've attached a mutual action plan with suggested milestones and a short questionnaire (fintechx-cost-questions.xlsx) you can fill — it will let us plug your numbers directly into our unit-econ model. Rishi (cc'd) will follow up with a short cost breakdown based on the numbers you shared.

Proposed next touch: 45-minute follow-up on Thu 6/17 to walk through the model and variants (quantized vs fp16, dedicated vs hosted). Does 10am PT work?

Thanks — talk soon.

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Sanjay and I chatted offline and provided the numbers we have today. See inline answers below and attached sample traffic.

1) Token estimates: steady ~30M tokens / month (aggregate across web + mobile chat). Pilot month expected ~5–10M (small cohort). Peak events (marketing campaigns) could push short bursts to ~120M in a month.
2) Target $/1M tokens: our finance team wants to see target operating cost closer to $4,000 per 1M tokens (this is what scales to our product economics).
3) Features per new user: primary LLM features are 3 per user (onboarding summary, in-chat suggestions, automated enrichment) — we estimate ~3 features hit per MAU.
4) Procurement: target procurement by end of Q3. We prefer a 12-month committed contract if pricing aligns.

A few other items:
- Current infra and vendor costs (approx): our on-prem + managed infra for inference today averages out to about $8,500 / 1M tokens (including ops & infra amortization) — this is a high-level number from finance.
- Security questionnaire will be shared with your security team next week.

Hi Claire / Sanjay — quick technical & unit-econ note ahead of Thu's call so we can use the time to validate assumptions rather than build them live. I've attached a simple model (redwood-unit-econ-model.xlsx) — below are the highlights and configurable knobs.

Summary points:
- Baseline inference cost assumptions (hosted API, mixed-concurrency profile, optimized kernel selection): ~ $1,800 - $3,200 per 1M tokens depending on quantization + caching (4-bit quantized + batching typically on the lower end).
- Example row: 4-bit quantized, dynamic batching, prefix caching for repeated assistant prompts -> estimated $1,900 / 1M tokens at 30M/month with p95 < 200ms on our Dedicated pool sizing.
- Tradeoffs: lower cost paths (4-bit quant) can add small delta in generation quality for certain prompts — we recommend A/B evals against production prompts.

Mapping to your asks:
- Target $4,000 / 1M: reachable with Hosted + conservative config but you get most margin improvement by committing to Dedicated monthly reserve (we can model a 20–40% discount vs hosted at 12-month commit) which pushes effective cost closer to $1,400–$2,400 / 1M depending on commit level and batching profile.
- $/feature: if avg response is 120 tokens and you have ~3 LLM features per user/month, cost per feature at 30M tokens/month looks like:
    * 1,900 $/1M -> effective $0.228 per 1k tokens -> per-feature ~ $0.027 (120 tokens ~0.12k) -> multiply by features as needed.
    * Scaling to 1M users with 3 features each would then map to monthly inference cost = (~360M tokens) -> ~ $684 - $1,080k/month range depending on config.
- CAC payback: to hit 6–9 month payback, we can backward-calculate allowed CAC given LTV and gross margin targets — preliminary: if your ARPU / new user yields $120 ARR and target gross margin after inference is 60%, acceptable CAC is roughly $72–$90. We should run your exact LTV numbers in the model.

Attachments / next steps:
- Attached: redwood-unit-econ-model.xlsx (editable) — plug in your ARPU, retention, and commit preferences; we'll produce a one-page recommendation showing cost per 1M, $/feature, and suggested commit tier to reach your $4k goal (or show gap analysis).
- We'll prepare two price/config variants for Thu's call: Hosted (no commit) and Dedicated 1-year commit with 20% and 35% discount tiers.

Looking forward to the call — sending calendar invite now.

--
